docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: JKV Global
docs.content: JKV Global provides access to global financial markets through trading accounts, MetaTrader 5, market instruments, educational resources and client support. JKV Global presents its service around a straightforward trading experience from account registration and verification through platform access, funding and withdrawals.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is JKV Global?
docs.content: JKV Global describes itself as a global forex broker founded by experienced trading professionals. The company provides access to financial instruments through trading accounts, MetaTrader 5, customer support and available deposit and withdrawal methods. JKV Global states that its team operates across the UAE and India and that more than 2,000 traders have been onboarded.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Is JKV Global regulated?
docs.content: JKV Global states that it is regulated by the Financial Services Commission of Mauritius. Regulator: Financial Services Commission, Mauritius. Licence number: GB23201820. Regulatory details should always be checked against the latest official JKV Global legal and regulatory disclosures.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How does JKV Global protect client funds?
docs.content: JKV Global states that client funds are held separately through segregated client-fund arrangements. The website also presents regulatory oversight and transparent pricing as key trust principles.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What account types does JKV Global offer?
docs.content: JKV Global presents four main trading account types: Business Account Prime Account Pro Account ECN Account The available account type should be selected according to the trader's requirements and current JKV Global trading conditions.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Business Account
docs.content: The Business Account states leverage of up to 1:400. Average spread: approximately 2.5 pips. Commission: 0. The website also associates the account with access to 20,000+ instruments, MetaTrader 5, MAM/PAMM capabilities, relationship management and market analysis.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Prime Account
docs.content: The Prime Account states leverage of up to 1:400. Average spread: approximately 1.5 pips. Commission: 0. The website also associates the account with access to 20,000+ instruments, MetaTrader 5, MAM/PAMM capabilities, relationship management and market analysis.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Pro Account
docs.content: The Pro Account states leverage of up to 1:400. Average spread: approximately 0.8 pips. Commission: 0. The website also associates the account with access to 20,000+ instruments, MetaTrader 5, MAM/PAMM capabilities, relationship management and market analysis.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: ECN Account
docs.content: The ECN Account states leverage of up to 1:400. Spreads: raw spreads. Commission: $5 as shown on the current website content. The website also associates the account with access to 20,000+ instruments, MetaTrader 5, MAM/PAMM capabilities, relationship management and market analysis.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What leverage does JKV Global offer?
docs.content: The current homepage account specifications state leverage of up to 1:400 for Business, Prime, Pro and ECN accounts. Certain product pages or trading conditions may contain instrument-specific information, so traders should confirm the latest leverage applicable to their account, instrument and jurisdiction before trading.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How many instruments are available?
docs.content: JKV Global's account information states access to more than 20,000 instruments. Product availability may depend on the account, trading platform and applicable trading conditions.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What markets can I trade?
docs.content: JKV Global provides access to a range of financial markets and instruments. These include forex, metals and CFDs linked to markets such as commodities, shares or stocks and indices. Available instruments and trading specifications should be confirmed through the latest JKV Global product information.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Which trading platform does JKV Global use?
docs.content: JKV Global provides access to MetaTrader 5, also known as MT5. MT5 is presented as a multi-asset electronic trading platform offering advanced trading, charting and order-management functionality.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Which devices support MetaTrader 5?
docs.content: JKV Global promotes MetaTrader 5 access across: Android iOS Desktop Web This allows clients to monitor and access their trading account across supported devices.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Can beginners use MetaTrader 5?
docs.content: JKV Global presents MT5 for both newer and experienced traders. The Education section of the website also provides beginner-focused material covering trading fundamentals, market analysis, platform tools and risk management.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global support hedging on MT5?
docs.content: The JKV Global MT5 content promotes flexible order placement and hedging without FIFO limitations. Availability and account conditions should be checked against the current platform and account terms.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global provide ECN connectivity?
docs.content: The MetaTrader 5 page refers to real-time ECN connectivity for SpotX accounts. Product and account availability should be confirmed against current JKV Global specifications.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How do I open a JKV Global account?
docs.content: The JKV Global website describes the process in three main stages. First, create an account and choose the appropriate account type. Second, complete identity verification and KYC requirements using the requested identification and address documents. Third, access the platform, fund the approved account and begin trading when ready.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What documents may be required?
docs.content: JKV Global may request identity and address documentation as part of KYC and account verification. The exact documents required can depend on the application and verification process.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Are there account setup fees?
docs.content: The JKV Global homepage FAQ states that account setup assistance is free. Trading costs and other account-related charges depend on the selected account and applicable conditions.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Do I get personal account support?
docs.content: The JKV Global website states that a dedicated account manager may be offered as part of its client support proposition.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Do I need previous trading experience?
docs.content: JKV Global states that previous trading experience is not required to begin learning. New traders are encouraged to use educational resources and understand the risks involved before trading with real funds.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Is a demo account available?
docs.content: Yes. JKV Global promotes a Try Demo option for users who want to explore the trading environment before opening or funding a live trading account.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How do I fund my JKV Global account?
docs.content: After registration and verification, clients can access their account and use available funding methods. The exact deposit methods, processing requirements and availability depend on the current account and payment options.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How long does a withdrawal take?
docs.content: The JKV Global homepage states that withdrawals can generally take approximately 24 to 72 hours after the relevant processing and verification requirements have been completed. Actual processing time may depend on verification, account status, payment method and other operational requirements.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Why can a withdrawal be delayed?
docs.content: Withdrawal processing may require account verification or compliance checks. Clients should ensure their account information and requested documents are complete and accurate. For an account-specific withdrawal issue, contact JKV Global support.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global offer social trading?
docs.content: Yes. JKV Global presents a social trading service that allows eligible users to follow trading providers or participate as strategy providers.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How does social trading work for followers?
docs.content: Followers can browse available providers and review information such as: ROI Drawdown Trading frequency Risk Followers can subscribe to an eligible provider, configure volume scaling and monitor performance.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: How does social trading work for providers?
docs.content: Eligible professional traders can register as providers, connect MetaTrader 5 and select an available subscription or performance model. Provider trades may then be copied in real time by subscribed followers.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is the social trading performance fee?
docs.content: The JKV Global website provides an example based on a 30% share of net profits for a provider. This is presented as an example and should not be interpreted as a universal fee for every provider or account. Current terms should be reviewed before subscribing or registering as a provider.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does social trading have risk controls?
docs.content: The JKV Global social trading content highlights a maximum-drawdown control. Copying another trader does not guarantee positive results and losses remain possible.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global provide trading education?
docs.content: Yes. JKV Global provides beginner-focused education covering forex trading and market fundamentals. Topics include: Forex market basics Introduction to forex trading Fundamental analysis Technical analysis Trading strategies MetaTrader tools Risk management Account setup

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Are JKV Global webinars free?
docs.content: The Education section states that webinars and beginner educational content are free.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global offer live Q&A?
docs.content: The JKV Global Education section states that live Q&A is available.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Are webinar recordings available?
docs.content: The website states that recordings may be available through Telegram and the JKV Global blog.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global have an Introducing Broker programme?
docs.content: Yes. JKV Global offers a partnership and Introducing Broker proposition. The programme is designed for partners who want to build a client network and receive commissions subject to the applicable partnership terms.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What support is available to JKV Global partners?
docs.content: The partnership proposition includes partner support, tracking and reporting. The website also refers to faster payouts and dedicated support for partners. Commercial terms and eligibility should be confirmed directly with JKV Global.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global provide swap-free accounts?
docs.content: The JKV Global partnership and terms content includes swap-free account provisions. Swap-free accounts are intended for eligible clients who cannot use conventional swaps because of their beliefs or choice. JKV Global may request justification or supporting information for the request. Swap-free terms supplement the normal client agreement and may include additional conditions.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Is forex trading risky?
docs.content: Yes. Forex and CFD trading involve financial risk. Leveraged trading can magnify both gains and losses. Clients should understand the products, trading conditions and risks before placing trades.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What scams does JKV Global warn traders about?
docs.content: JKV Global's trading safety content highlights risks including: Signal-seller scams Unregulated brokers Fraudulent managed-account schemes Clients should verify communications and avoid sharing sensitive account information with unverified parties.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Can the chatbot give trading signals?
docs.content: No. The JKV Global chatbot does not provide personal investment advice, trading signals, guaranteed returns or specific trade recommendations. It provides information based on approved JKV Global website content.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Can I use a VPS with JKV Global?
docs.content: The published JKV Global legal information states that VPS use for trading is prohibited unless specifically approved. Clients who require VPS use should contact the support desk from their registered email and follow the applicable approval process. JKV Global reserves the right to update its VPS policy.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Does JKV Global have scalping rules?
docs.content: The JKV Global Terms and Conditions include provisions relating to scalping. The published terms describe trades under 120 seconds as scalping and also address certain high-frequency activity involving VPS or algorithmic trading. Clients should review the current Terms and Conditions before using high-frequency, automated or scalping strategies.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What are JKV Global support hours?
docs.content: The JKV Global Contact page states support hours of: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Is WhatsApp support available?
docs.content: Yes. The JKV Global Contact page states that one-to-one WhatsApp support is available.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Do I need to visit an office for support?
docs.content: No. The Contact page states that an office visit is not necessary for general assistance. Clients can contact JKV Global through available remote support channels.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What does the JKV Global Privacy Policy cover?
docs.content: The JKV Global Privacy Policy covers data processing and applicable user rights. These include rights relating to: Access Rectification Erasure Restriction Data portability Objection These rights remain subject to applicable law and the current Privacy Policy.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Where can I find legal information?
docs.content: JKV Global provides legal and disclosure information through its Legal, Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions sections. Clients should review the applicable legal documentation before opening an account or trading.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is forex?
docs.content: Forex, or foreign exchange, is the global market where currencies are exchanged and traded in pairs. Currencies are traded relative to one another, such as EUR/USD or GBP/USD.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is a CFD?
docs.content: A CFD, or Contract for Difference, allows a trader to speculate on the price movement of a market without owning the underlying asset. CFDs are leveraged products and involve significant risk.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is leverage?
docs.content: Leverage allows a trader to control a larger position using a smaller amount of margin. Leverage increases market exposure and can magnify both profits and losses.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is a spread?
docs.content: The spread is the difference between the bid and ask price of a trading instrument. Trading spreads vary according to the account, instrument and market conditions.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is margin?
docs.content: Margin is the amount of capital required to open or maintain a leveraged position. Margin requirements depend on the product, leverage and account conditions.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is KYC?
docs.content: KYC means Know Your Customer. It is an identity-verification process used during account registration and for applicable compliance requirements.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: What is a demo account?
docs.content: A demo account allows users to explore a trading platform using simulated funds rather than real capital. It can be used to become familiar with platform functionality before live trading.

docs.title: JKV Global Help Centre
docs.heading: Important Information
docs.content: Trading securities, forex, CFDs, commodities, options and other leveraged financial products involves significant risk. Losses can occur and leveraged trading may result in losses greater than the amount initially committed where applicable. Information provided by the JKV Global chatbot is general website information only. It does not constitute personal investment, legal, tax or financial advice. Clients should review the latest official JKV Global trading conditions, legal documents and risk disclosures before making trading decisions.
